analyst.summary: Indian Overseas Bank, a public-sector bank, continues a multi-year recovery: asset quality has improved sharply (gross bad loans down to about 1.3% of the book, from over 2% a year ago) and profit grew strongly through FY26, with rating agencies upgrading the bank's bond ratings. Government ownership remains high and will likely be reduced gradually over time to meet listing rules, a modest and well-flagged overhang rather than a new risk. We rate it a Hold.
